title: Start with a storyboard before editing to speed up your Seedance workflow and…
content:
Start with a storyboard before editing to speed up your Seedance workflow and keep direction clear  
Generate a storyboard with VideoDuck GPT Image 2, then use Seedance 2.0 to convert that storyboard into a finished video  
Use a single prompt in VideoDuck to produce the full storyboard and final Seedance video in one streamlined flow
